title: Combinatorial aspects of normal ordering of 3-dimensional skew polynomial rings
summary: In this paper, we discuss combinatorial aspects of normal ordering of 3-dimensional skew polynomial rings defined and classified by Bell and Smith \cite{BellSmith1990}. With some help of the Mathematical software \texttt{SageMath}, we are able to reduce the length of computation of PBW forms and normal orderings appearing in commutation rules of these algebras.
